ALL-STAFF MAIL - Harwick & Lowe Commercial Bank, Collections Operations
Wed 13 Oct 2026, 09:05 UTC
Subject: S-72: one correction to signed memo M-77

Colleagues, a single correction to yesterday's signed memo M-77.

Item M-3 of that memo restricted telephone contact days to the business day following the call.
That item is withdrawn. Amendment C therefore means:

    Telephone contact days are today or the next business day, exactly as clause 3.1 of the
    O&M Policy says. The contact hours stated in M-3 remain: 09:00 to 18:00 inclusive.

This correction is made under our standard authority. All other items of M-77 stand, and clause
3.2 keeps its meaning. The O&M Policy and M-77 are reissued with the pack, newest first.

H. Okonkwo, Manager, Collections Operations Division, Harwick & Lowe Commercial Bank.
Ref. HL/OPS/S-72; file ECHL.
